guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：超導奈米線單光子偵測器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
guides.concept: 從偏置在臨界電流附近的 NbN 或 WSi 奈米線出發，說明一個 0.8 eV 的 1550 nm 光子如何讓整個截面失超並送出 mV 級脈衝，再把光學腔吸收、薄膜與奈米微影、L_k/R 重置、可溯源效率校正、暗計數與時間抖動、2.5 K 低溫整合與操作點選擇串成可交接的單光子接收機紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from an NbN or WSi nanowire biased near its critical current, show how one 0.8 eV photon at 1550 nm drives the whole cross-section normal and launches a millivolt pulse, then link optical-cavity absorption, film growth and nanolithography, L_k/R reset, traceable efficiency calibration, dark counts and timing jitter, 2.5 K cryogenic integration and operating-point choice into a transferable single-photon receiver record.
procedure: 超導奈米線通常是厚 5 到 7 nm、寬約 100 nm 的 NbN 或 WSi 曲折線，冷到臨界溫度以下並以直流偏置在臨界電流 Ic 的九成左右。吸收一個光子後，能量打斷庫柏對並產生大量準粒子與聲子，形成局部的抑制超導區；電流被迫繞過這個熱點，旁邊截面的電流密度超過臨界值，整段截面轉為約 kΩ 的電阻態。由於這個電阻遠大於 50 Ω 的讀出負載，偏置電流轉入放大器形成電壓脈衝，熱點冷卻後超導恢復、電流再經動態電感流回奈米線。偏置越靠近 Ic，能量越低的光子也能觸發，但暗計數同時上升。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

系統偵測效率是三項的乘積：光纖到奈米線的耦合、奈米線對光的吸收，以及吸收後產生脈衝的內部效率。數奈米厚的 NbN 單次通過只吸收約三成，因此把奈米線放在四分之一波長介電間隔層與金屬鏡或分散式布拉格反射鏡形成的光學腔中，讓吸收提高到九成以上。曲折線的填充因子與線方向造成偏振相依：電場平行於線時吸收較強。單模光纖在 1550 nm 的模場直徑約 10.4 µm，主動區必須大於光點並容納對準誤差，這又牽動線長與重置速度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光學腔與吸收堆疊」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NbN 以反應式磁控濺鍍沉積在矽、氧化矽或預先鍍好的反射鏡堆疊上，厚度與氮含量決定 Tc 與每方塊數百歐姆的片電阻；WSi 等非晶材料對基板晶格不敏感、內部效率平台寬，但 Tc 只有數 K，需要 1 K 以下操作。電子束微影與反應式離子蝕刻定義 100 nm 線寬、200 nm 節距的曲折線，轉角做成圓弧以減少電流擁擠。整條線的 Ic 由最窄或最薄的一點決定，單一縮頸就會限制整個偵測器能用的偏置。庫柏對的動能使奈米線具有動態電感，與長寬比成正比。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NbN 濺鍍薄膜與電子束曲折線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

熱點消失後，偏置電流以 I(t) = I_b(1 − e^(−t/τ)) 回流，時間常數 τ = L_k/R_L 由動態電感與讀出負載決定；電流還沒回到接近 I_b 前，偵測效率偏低，因此死時間約為數個 τ。縮短奈米線可降低 L_k 而加快重置，但若電流回流速度快於熱點冷卻，奈米線會被焦耳熱維持在電阻態而閂鎖，必須切斷偏置才能恢復。高計數率時 AC 耦合放大器的基線偏移也會分走偏置電流。交錯式多像素陣列把光分給多條較短的線，同時兼顧速度與耦合面積。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「動態電感與 50 Ω 讀出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

系統偵測效率必須定義在明確的參考面，通常是低溫恆溫器外的光纖接頭。做法是讓 1550 nm 雷射先經校正過的光功率計量測，再串接數個已校正的光纖衰減器把功率降到每秒約十萬個光子，於偏振控制器掃描下記錄計數率，扣除暗計數後除以光子通量。功率計需可溯源到國家計量標準，並在實際使用的功率與波長點驗證線性；衰減器的重複性、接頭插拔與光纖彎曲損失都要列入不確定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正衰減器與功率計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

暗計數分為本質與外來兩類：本質暗計數來自靠近 Ic 時的磁通渦旋穿越與相位滑移，隨偏置指數上升；外來暗計數主要是室溫黑體輻射沿光纖傳進來的光子與雜散光，可用低溫端的光纖彎繞或濾波器抑制。時間抖動由放大器雜訊除以脈衝斜率、長奈米線上脈衝傳播位置不同造成的幾何抖動、熱點本身的隨機性，以及計時電子學共同決定，以平方和相加。雜訊等效功率 NEP = hν·√(2·DCR)/η 把效率與暗計數合成一個指標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「暗計數與時間抖動直方圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NbN 元件通常在 Gifford–McMahon 或脈衝管冷頭的 2.5 K 級操作，WSi 或 MoSi 元件則需要吸附式 He-3 等附加級降到 0.8 K 左右。光纖與同軸線穿過 40 K 與 4 K 級時都要熱錨定，同軸線材質決定熱負載與訊號衰減；偏置透過 bias tee 注入，放大器可放在室溫或低溫級。冷頭以約 1 Hz 振動，若光纖與晶片沒有自對準封裝，振動會調變耦合效率。溫度變化直接改變 Ic，使固定偏置下的 I_b/Ic 漂移，進而改變效率與暗計數；接地迴路與射頻干擾則產生假計數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「2.5 K 閉循環低溫恆溫器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收把前面的模型逐項轉成量測：效率對偏置曲線與平台寬度、暗計數對偏置、操作點的時間抖動直方圖、事件間隔直方圖得到的重置時間、計數率飽和曲線、偏振比、降溫時間與溫度穩定度，以及閂鎖門檻。操作點不是單看最高效率，而是依應用指標選擇：量子金鑰分配看金鑰率與錯誤率，深空光通訊看抖動與脈衝位置調變時槽寬，光達看距離解析度。交接紀錄要列出每個通道的 Ic、偏置、溫度、放大器設定與參考面定義。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收曲線與應用鏈路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A superconducting nanowire is typically a meander of NbN or WSi 5 to 7 nm thick and about 100 nm wide, cooled below its critical temperature and DC-biased at about 90% of its critical current Ic. An absorbed photon breaks Cooper pairs and creates a cloud of quasiparticles and phonons, forming a local region of suppressed superconductivity; current is forced around this hotspot, the neighbouring cross-section exceeds the critical current density and the whole section turns resistive at about a kilohm. Because that resistance far exceeds the 50 Ω readout load, the bias current diverts into the amplifier as a voltage pulse; the hotspot then cools, superconductivity returns and current flows back into the wire through its kinetic inductance. Biasing closer to Ic lets lower-energy photons trigger but also raises dark counts. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

System detection efficiency is the product of three terms: fibre-to-nanowire coupling, absorption in the nanowire and the internal efficiency of turning an absorption into a pulse. A few-nanometre NbN film absorbs only about 30% in a single pass, so the nanowire sits in an optical cavity formed by a quarter-wave dielectric spacer and a metal mirror or distributed Bragg reflector, raising absorption above 90%. The meander fill factor and wire direction make absorption polarisation-dependent, stronger with the electric field parallel to the wires. Single-mode fibre has a mode-field diameter of about 10.4 µm at 1550 nm, so the active area must exceed the spot and absorb alignment error, which in turn sets wire length and reset speed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Optical cavity and absorber stack”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

NbN is grown by reactive magnetron sputtering on silicon, silicon oxide or a pre-deposited mirror stack, and thickness and nitrogen content set Tc and a sheet resistance of several hundred ohms per square; amorphous WSi is insensitive to substrate lattice and has a broad internal-efficiency plateau, but its Tc of a few kelvin requires sub-kelvin operation. Electron-beam lithography and reactive-ion etching define a meander with 100 nm lines on a 200 nm pitch, with rounded bends to reduce current crowding. The whole wire's Ic is set by its narrowest or thinnest point, so a single constriction limits the usable bias of the entire detector. The kinetic energy of Cooper pairs gives the wire a kinetic inductance proportional to its length-to-width ratio. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sputtered NbN film and e-beam meander”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

After the hotspot vanishes the bias current returns as I(t) = I_b(1 − e^(−t/τ)), with τ = L_k/R_L set by kinetic inductance and the readout load; until the current is close to I_b the efficiency is reduced, so the dead time is several τ. Shortening the wire lowers L_k and speeds reset, but if current returns faster than the hotspot cools, Joule heating holds the wire resistive and it latches until the bias is removed. At high count rates the baseline shift of an AC-coupled amplifier also steals bias current. Interleaved multi-pixel arrays share light among several shorter wires to combine speed with coupling area. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Kinetic inductance and 50 Ω readout”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

System detection efficiency must be defined at an explicit reference plane, usually the fibre connector outside the cryostat. A 1550 nm laser is first measured with a calibrated optical power meter, then passed through several calibrated fibre attenuators that reduce it to about one hundred thousand photons per second, and the count rate is recorded while a polarisation controller is scanned; dark counts are subtracted and the result divided by the photon flux. The power meter must be traceable to a national standard and verified for linearity at the power and wavelength used, while attenuator repeatability, connector remating and fibre-bend loss all enter the uncertainty. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibrated attenuators and power meter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Dark counts are intrinsic or extrinsic: intrinsic counts come from vortex crossings and phase slips near Ic and grow exponentially with bias, while extrinsic counts are mostly room-temperature blackbody photons guided down the fibre plus stray light, suppressed by cold fibre loops or filters. Timing jitter combines amplifier noise divided by pulse slope, geometric jitter from where along a long wire the pulse starts, intrinsic hotspot randomness and the timing electronics, added in quadrature. The noise-equivalent power NEP = hν·√(2·DCR)/η merges efficiency and dark counts into one figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Dark counts and jitter histogram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

NbN devices usually run on the 2.5 K stage of a Gifford–McMahon or pulse-tube cold head, while WSi or MoSi devices need an added sorption He-3 stage to reach about 0.8 K. Fibres and coaxial lines must be heat-sunk as they pass the 40 K and 4 K stages, and the coax material sets heat load and signal attenuation; bias enters through a bias tee and the amplifier may sit at room temperature or on a cold stage. The cold head vibrates at about 1 Hz, which modulates coupling unless fibre and chip are in a self-aligned package. Temperature changes shift Ic directly, so a fixed bias drifts in I_b/Ic and changes efficiency and dark counts, while ground loops and RF interference create false counts. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “2.5 K closed-cycle cryostat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance turns the earlier models into measurements: efficiency versus bias and plateau width, dark counts versus bias, the jitter histogram at the operating point, reset time from the inter-event histogram, the count-rate saturation curve, polarisation ratio, cooldown time and temperature stability, and the latching threshold. The operating point is chosen not for maximum efficiency alone but by the application metric: secret-key rate and error rate for quantum key distribution, jitter against pulse-position-modulation slot width for deep-space optical links, and range resolution for lidar. The handoff record lists each channel's Ic, bias, temperature, amplifier settings and reference-plane definition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance curves and application link”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 偏置設得太低時只有部分光子能形成跨越整個截面的電阻區，計數率對偏置仍陡峭上升，效率對溫度與偏置漂移極度敏感；偏置設得太接近 Ic 則暗計數呈指數上升，在低光量量測中被誤認為訊號。
只報告偏振最大時的效率，應用端使用非偏振光時實際效率少一成；衰減器只在 1310 nm 校正卻用在 1550 nm，衰減值偏差 0.2 dB，效率被系統性高估 5%，不同實驗室的數字無法比較。
pitfallsEn: Biasing too low lets only some photons create a resistive region across the full cross-section, so count rate still climbs steeply with bias and efficiency becomes hypersensitive to temperature and bias drift; biasing too close to Ic makes dark counts grow exponentially and they are mistaken for signal in low-light measurements.

Reporting only the polarisation-maximum efficiency leaves users with unpolarised light 10% short; attenuators calibrated only at 1310 nm but used at 1550 nm can be off by 0.2 dB, overstating efficiency by 5% so numbers from different laboratories cannot be compared.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超導奈米線單光子偵測器
history.text: 2001 年 Gol'tsman、Sobolewski 等人以數奈米厚的 NbN 窄條首次展示超導奈米線的單光子偵測；2013 年 NIST 與 JPL 團隊以 WSi 奈米線加光學腔在 1550 nm 達到約 93% 的系統偵測效率。同年 NASA 月球雷射通訊示範的地面站採用 SNSPD 陣列接收機，2023 年 Psyche 任務的深空光通訊實驗也以 SNSPD 陣列在帕洛馬天文台接收雷射訊號。如今 Single Quantum、ID Quantique 等公司提供多通道商用系統。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 2001 Gol'tsman, Sobolewski and colleagues first demonstrated single-photon detection with a superconducting strip of few-nanometre NbN; in 2013 a NIST and JPL team reached about 93% system detection efficiency at 1550 nm with WSi nanowires in an optical cavity. The same year the ground terminal of NASA's Lunar Laser Communication Demonstration used SNSPD array receivers, and in 2023 the Deep Space Optical Communications experiment on the Psyche mission received laser signals at Palomar Observatory with an SNSPD array. Companies such as Single Quantum and ID Quantique now supply multichannel commercial systems. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生」到「系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation" through "System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
